query:
ALTER TABLE comments ADD COLUMN timestamp INT NULL COMMENT 'video timestamp in seconds';

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS videoReactions (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  userId INT NOT NULL,
  videoId INT NOT NULL,
  reactionType ENUM('love', 'laugh', 'wow', 'sad', 'fire', 'clap', 'thinking', 'heart_eyes') NOT NULL,
  timestamp INT NOT NULL COMMENT 'video timestamp in seconds',
  createdAt TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  INDEX idx_video_timestamp (videoId, timestamp),
  INDEX idx_user_video (userId, videoId)
);
